ios.desc:
Whether you are a shift worker, freelancer, or juggling gigs, Flexishift is the ultimate personal time tracker. Clock in seamlessly, manage schedules, and let smart automation handle the rest.

▸ TRACK TIME EFFORTLESSLY
Start the timer with a tap or log shifts manually. Track breaks yourself or set them to run automatically.

▸ SEE EARNINGS IN REAL TIME
Set your hourly rate and watch your income calculate as you work. Easily add tips, bonuses, and manual adjustments.

▸ AUTOMATIC OVERTIME
Enter your schedule and let Flexishift automatically calculate your overtime pay at a glance.

▸ ORGANIZE MULTIPLE ROLES & GIGS
Track hours, pay, and schedules for different employers, freelance clients, or gig platforms entirely separate from one another.

▸ FLEXIBLE ROUNDING
Match your employer's rules. Round work and break times—or durations—up, down, or to the nearest interval.

▸ MANAGE TIME OFF
Log vacation, sick leave, and holidays to keep your records perfectly accurate.

▸ LOCATION AUTOMATION
Set a geofence for your workplace and let Flexishift clock you in and out automatically as you arrive and leave.

▸ SMART REMINDERS
Get helpful nudges to clock in and out based on your upcoming schedule.

▸ APPLE WATCH & LIVE ACTIVITIES
View and control your timer directly from your wrist, Lock Screen, or Dynamic Island.

▸ WIDGETS, SIRI & SHORTCUTS
Check hours right from your Home Screen. Use Siri or Apple Shortcuts to automate your daily tracking routines.

▸ EXPORT TIMESHEETS*
Generate polished work logs to share or print as PDF, CSV, or HTML.

Try Flexishift for Free
Get started by managing up to 3 jobs and logging up to 5 shift entries at a time.

Flexishift Pro
Upgrade to Pro to unlock unlimited shift entries and full timesheet exports. Available as a secure in-app purchase (charged to your Apple ID upon confirmation).

Privacy Policy: https://flexishiftapp.com/privacy-policy/en
Terms of Use: https://flexishiftapp.com/terms-of-use/en

*Feature requires Flexishift Pro.

quotes.text:
I've been making $500-1000/month on an iOS app for work time tracking –  https://apps.apple.com/us/app/flexishift-work-hours-pay/id1146576087

When I started the project, the category seemed quite crowded already, but I couldn't find anything good for tracking my hours in a flextime arrangement. I had no iOS experience at that time (I was a C++ developer) and now I do iOS development as my full-time job too.
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: Those making $500/month on side projects in 2022 – Show and tell
